before.title: How do you prevent virtual event failures? | West Peek Productions
before.description: Virtual event failures are prevented by rehearsing speakers, assigning producer roles, testing links and permissions, preparing backup rooms, documenting show cues, moderating audience flow, and defining escalation paths before the live room opens.
